pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: The dark contiguous regions consist of irregular polygons with high edge angularity and sharp pixel-level gradients. Spatial area is largest on the mid-flank, becoming progressively smaller and more elongated toward the ventral and hind regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored pathways form a continuous, interlocking topological graph. Junction nodes primarily exhibit tri-radial and quadri-radial configurations. Pixel thickness is relatively uniform across the flank, maintaining clear separation between dark patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged contour against the background. The silhouette is consistent until the mid-neck region.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A localized discontinuity in the continuous mane line is visible where two avian subjects are perched, obscuring the structural profile at the shoulder-neck junction.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two dark-plumaged birds (oxpeckers) perched on the upper dorsal ridge at the base of the neck.
